description: This file contains the implementation of complex number mathematical functions for spreadsheet calculations within the PHPSpreadsheet library. It defines a class 'ComplexFunctions' with static methods for operations like absolute value, argument, conjugate, various trigonometric and hyperbolic functions, logarithms, roots, exponential, and power for complex numbers.

classes.name: ComplexFunctions
classes.description: A collection of static methods providing complex number calculation functions for spreadsheets.

methods.name: IMABS
methods.description: Returns the absolute value (modulus) of a complex number.

methods.name: IMARGUMENT
methods.description: Returns the argument (theta) of a complex number in radians.

methods.name: IMCONJUGATE
methods.description: Returns the conjugate of a complex number.

methods.name: IMCOS
methods.description: Returns the cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: IMCOSH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of a complex number.

methods.name: IMCOT
methods.description: Returns the cotangent of a complex number.

methods.name: IMCSC
methods.description: Returns the cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: IMCSCH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic cosecant of a complex number.

methods.name: IMSIN
methods.description: Returns the sine of a complex number.

methods.name: IMSINH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic sine of a complex number.

methods.name: IMSEC
methods.description: Returns the secant of a complex number.

methods.name: IMSECH
methods.description: Returns the hyperbolic secant of a complex number.

methods.name: IMTAN
methods.description: Returns the tangent of a complex number.

methods.name: IMSQRT
methods.description: Returns the square root of a complex number.

methods.name: IMLN
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: IMLOG10
methods.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: IMLOG2
methods.description: Returns the base-2 logarithm of a complex number.

methods.name: IMEXP
methods.description: Returns the exponential of a complex number.

methods.name: IMPOWER
methods.description: Raises a complex number to a specified power.
